dossier.scp_unleashed.343.title: God
dossier.scp_unleashed.343.caption: SCP-343 in a facility corridor, moments after he stepped out of its wall.

page.title: Special Containment Procedures:
text: SCP-343 cannot be contained by any means tested, and he has shown no wish to cause trouble. He is to be offered a quiet, comfortable room, which he may leave and return to as he pleases.
**Do not lock SCP-343 in.** Each attempt has ended the same way, and the Foundation has stopped making them.
Staff may speak with him freely. All personnel are reminded that violence of any kind is forbidden in his presence.

page.title: Description:
text: SCP-343 is an elderly man of great calm, with long white hair, a full white beard that reaches his chest, and simple pale robes tied with a gold sash. A faint warm light seems to hang about him. He calls himself God, and has never tried to prove it.
SCP-343 is unfailingly kind. He speaks gently with anyone who comes to him, and those who do often report feeling rested, healed or encouraged for some time afterward.
No harm of any kind has ever come to SCP-343. %rNothing reaches him.%r

SCP-343 does not stay where he is shut in. Staff who sealed his room have watched him walk calmly into a wall and not come out on the other side. He has always come back, sometimes days later and far from where he left.
He will not abide cruelty. %rDo not raise a hand against anyone near him.%r

page.title: Addendum 343-1: Arrival
text: SCP-343 has no recovery record. He first appeared a few minutes after this file was read, stepping out of a wall near the reader as if through an open door. He greeted the reader warmly and asked whether they had been sleeping well.
He has arrived the same way each time since.

page.title: Addendum 343-2: Incident Log
text: Incident 343-02: a guard struck a junior researcher in front of SCP-343. The guard was gone in a moment, and only a soft light remained where he had stood. %rHe was not seen again.%r

Incident 343-05: after weeks of his coming and going, staff furnished an empty hall with a great carved seat. SCP-343 has rarely left that wing since. Asked why, he said only: "It is good to be expected."

block.scp_unleashed.scp343_throne.toolti: A seat fit for a guest who will not be kept.
message.scp_unleashed.scp343.blessed: A gentle warmth settles over you.
message.scp_unleashed.scp343.refuses: SCP-343 smiles, and the controller finds nothing to take hold of
message.scp_unleashed.scp343.line.0: You are doing better than you think.
message.scp_unleashed.scp343.line.1: Rest a while. The work will wait.
message.scp_unleashed.scp343.line.2: Be gentle with each other down there.
message.scp_unleashed.scp343.line.3: I see how hard you try. It matters.
message.scp_unleashed.scp343.line.4: Every small kindness travels further than you know.
message.scp_unleashed.scp343.line.5: You carry a great deal. Set some of it down for a moment.
message.scp_unleashed.scp343.line.6: There is no shame in being tired.
message.scp_unleashed.scp343.line.7: Look after the ones beside you. They are looking after you too.
message.scp_unleashed.scp343.line.8: Drink some water, and eat something warm today.
message.scp_unleashed.scp343.line.9: The sun will rise again soon. It always does.
message.scp_unleashed.scp343.line.10: No one expects you to be perfect. Only to keep going.
message.scp_unleashed.scp343.line.11: I am glad you came to talk with me.
message.scp_unleashed.scp343.line.12: Your mistakes do not make you any less worth caring for.
message.scp_unleashed.scp343.line.14: Walk slowly today, and notice something lovely.
message.scp_unleashed.scp343.line.15: Even the longest night is still only a night.
message.scp_unleashed.scp343.line.16: You have more friends than you realise.
message.scp_unleashed.scp343.line.17: Hope is a small thing, but it is very hard to break.
message.scp_unleashed.scp343.line.18: Forgive yourself a little. It helps.
message.scp_unleashed.scp343.line.19: Thank you for your patience with this strange place.
message.scp_unleashed.scp343.line.20: Laugh when you can. It is good for you.
message.scp_unleashed.scp343.line.21: The world is kinder for having you in it.
message.scp_unleashed.scp343.line.22: Be brave, but be kind first.
message.scp_unleashed.scp343.line.23: Whatever you are building, I hope it brings you joy.
message.scp_unleashed.scp343.line.24: Take care of those hands. They do good work.
message.scp_unleashed.scp343.line.26: There is nothing to fear from me. I only wish you well.
message.scp_unleashed.scp343.line.27: Go gently. We will speak again.
message.scp_unleashed.scp343.greeting.0: There you are. I hoped we would meet.
message.scp_unleashed.scp343.greeting.1: Hello, friend. You look like you could use a kind word.
message.scp_unleashed.scp343.greeting.2: Ah, a new face. A welcome one.
message.scp_unleashed.scp343.greeting.3: Good to see you. Walk with me a little, if you like.
message.scp_unleashed.scp343.parting.0: Walls are no trouble to me. I will come back.
message.scp_unleashed.scp343.parting.1: I do not stay where I am kept. Do not worry about me.
message.scp_unleashed.scp343.parting.2: I must go for a while. Be well until then.
SCP-343, "God": an elderly man in pale robes with long white hair and a full white beard. He is Safe-class and gentle with everyone.
He does not occur naturally. Some time after his archive file is read, he steps out of a wall near the reader.
Speaking with him lifts the spirits. He does not care to be shut in.
Cruelty is not tolerated in his presence.
jei.scp_unleashed.info.scp343_throne.1: A grand throne of carved white stone and gold, made in the Advanced Assembler.
jei.scp_unleashed.info.scp343_throne.3: A seat fit for a guest who will not be kept.

archive.scp_unleashed.notes.scp343.1: Speak with him. You will feel better for it.
